title: Check: Comparing Aerobic and Anaerobic Respiration (C)

questions.stem: Which statement correctly compares the products of anaerobic respiration in animals and yeast?

options.text: Animals produce ethanol; yeast produces lactic acid
Both produce ethanol and carbon dioxide
Animals produce lactic acid; yeast produces ethanol and carbon dioxide

questions.explanation: In animals, anaerobic respiration produces lactic acid. In yeast (and plants), it produces ethanol and carbon dioxide. This is a key difference tested at GCSE level.
